title: ProteinMPNN design of right-handed antiparallel four-helix coiled coils
summary: Removing sequence-repeat constraints raised the fraction of ProteinMPNN designs meeting structural confidence and topology criteria from 0.44% to 2.80%, and heterotetramer design gave 3.04%. Five of six experimentally characterized designs were predominantly alpha-helical, with apparent melting temperatures of 55.2 to 72.5 C. The crystal structure of the most stable design, Heteromer-2, at 1.92 A matched the computational model with a backbone RMSD of 0.45 A. Only six designs were characterized; this is a preprint.
ai_technology: ProteinMPNN sequence design on parametric coiled-coil backbones with structure-prediction filtering

evidence.tested: Six designs characterized by split-luciferase assay, CD and MD; Heteromer-2 solved by X-ray crystallography at 1.92 A.
evidence.unknown: Only six designs tested; preprint; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ProteinMPNN sequence design with deep-learning structure prediction on parametric backbones
